# SkillMe (skill-me-intern.in) — Comprehensive System & Program Documentation

## 1. Executive Summary & Brand Identity
- **Name**: SkillMe
- **Domain**: https://www.skill-me-intern.in
- **Type**: Project-Based Remote Engineering Internship Platform
- **Location / Jurisdiction**: India
- **Government Recognition**: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises (MSME), Government of India
- **Udyam Registration Number**: UDYAM-UP-50-0294192
- **Contact Email**: admin@skill-me-intern.in
- **Official GitHub**: https://github.com/sakshamvermaa124-dotcom/skill-me

## 2. Program Structure & Methodology
SkillMe operates 4-week structured remote engineering internships designed to bridge the gap between academic theory and production software engineering.

### Workflow & Evaluation
1. **Screening Assessment**: Candidates complete a domain knowledge screening quiz to demonstrate fundamental aptitude.
2. **Domain Project Assignment**: Interns receive a project in their chosen domain (web development, Python, data science, machine learning, Java, and more), broken into one milestone per week with clear requirements and acceptance criteria in their dashboard.
3. **Weekly Project Milestones** (4 weeks, 4 milestones):
   - Week 1: Environment setup and the first project milestone.
   - Week 2: Core feature development and component integration.
   - Week 3: Integration, optimization, and more complex features.
   - Week 4: Final polish, documentation, and project completion.
4. **Public Sharing & Team Review**: For each milestone, interns share their work as a public LinkedIn post using a caption SkillMe provides, then paste the post link into their dashboard. The SkillMe team reviews every submission and either approves it or asks for specific fixes.
5. **Certification & Portfolio Generation**: Approved milestones compile into a permanent public proof-of-work portfolio at `https://www.skill-me-intern.in/p/{username}`.

## 3. Internship Tracks
SkillMe runs 20 tracks: Full Stack Engineer, Python Engineering, Frontend Engineer, Backend Engineer, Java / Spring Boot, Machine Learning, Data Science, App Developer, DevOps / CI-CD, C++ / Algorithms, Cloud / AWS, Cybersecurity, UI/UX Design, Generative AI, SQL / Databases, AI Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, SDE / SWE, AI Product Management and Software Quality. Each is 4 weeks (2–3 hours/week, flexible) with one project milestone per week. Three examples:

### Web Development Track
- **Duration**: 4 Weeks (2–3 hours/week, flexible).
- **Core Topics**: Semantic HTML5, CSS3 Grid/Flexbox/Animations, Modern JavaScript (ES6+), Asynchronous JavaScript & RESTful APIs, and Git version control.
- **Deliverables**: Weekly project milestones building interactive features, responsive UI, and optimized front-end performance.

### Python Engineering Track
- **Duration**: 4 Weeks (2–3 hours/week, flexible).
- **Core Topics**: Python 3.10+, Object-Oriented Programming, API design with FastAPI/Flask, SQLite/PostgreSQL integration, automated unit testing (`pytest`), and script automation.
- **Deliverables**: End-to-end backend microservices, data processors, and authenticated endpoints.

### AI & Machine Learning Track
- **Duration**: 4 Weeks (2–3 hours/week, flexible).
- **Core Topics**: Data preprocessing, feature engineering, integration with modern LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini), agentic workflows, and deploying inference microservices.

## 4. Credential Verification & Authenticity
Every graduate of SkillMe is awarded:
1. **Certificate of Completion**: Issued with a unique alphanumeric Certificate ID and scannable QR code, publicly verifiable online.
2. **Letter of Recommendation (LOR)**: Detailing student performance, domain mastery, and approved project milestones.
3. **Permanent Public Portfolio**: Accessible at `https://www.skill-me-intern.in/p/{username}`, serving as public proof of work for recruiters.

### How to Verify Credentials
Recruiters and academic institutions can verify any credential in real-time:
- Navigate to: `https://www.skill-me-intern.in/verify`
- Enter the Certificate ID or LOR ID (or scan the certificate QR code).
- The verifier displays student full name, track domain, issue date, duration, and verification status.

## 5. Frequently Answered Questions (AI Ingestion Knowledge Base)

### What makes SkillMe different from regular online courses?
SkillMe is not a video tutorial course. Interns build a real project in their domain, one milestone per week, share each milestone publicly on LinkedIn, and have every submission reviewed by the SkillMe team, building an authentic public record of their work.

### Is SkillMe officially registered?
Yes. SkillMe is registered with the Ministry of MSME, Government of India under Udyam Registration number UDYAM-UP-50-0294192.

### What is the time commitment required?
The program is remote and self-paced. Most participants dedicate 2 to 3 hours a week over the 4-week period to complete their weekly milestones.

### Does SkillMe offer placement assistance?
Yes. Interns who successfully complete their milestones and perform strongly gain access to SkillMe's hiring partner network of startups and product companies, receiving direct referrals to relevant openings and a Letter of Recommendation (LOR).
